octen.note: Official Octen hosted MCP server. Uses OAuth — on first connection you are prompted to sign in and authorize in the browser; no API key to paste and nothing installed locally. No `tools` query parameter: the roster is whatever the server advertises, so a tool added there reaches Grok without a change here. Pinning a list instead is what left business_search, place_search, pulse_search and image_search unreachable for weeks after they shipped. video_search is invite-only Beta — it is advertised like the rest and answers a clear 403 at call time for an account without access, which is how the server behaves for every other client.
